description: Customer wants a 7kW EV charger (e.g. Ohme/Zappi) fitted on the front wall of the house. Consumer unit is in the hallway about 8m from the charge point, driveway parking.
Replace old fuse box with a modern metal consumer unit with RCBOs and surge protection. 10 circuits, 3-bed semi.
Landlord needs an EICR for a 3-bed terraced rental property before new tenants move in. No known issues.
Add two double sockets in the living room and one in the bedroom. Walls are brick, happy for surface trunking if easier.

Need power run to a new garden office at the bottom of the garden, about 20m from the house. Wants lights, 4 sockets and a small heater circuit. Armoured cable buried, small consumer unit in the office.
Power keeps tripping in the kitchen since last night, half the sockets dead. Need someone out urgently to find the fault.
Swap the old fluorescent strip in the kitchen for 6 LED downlights, dimmable. Existing ceiling, access from loft above.
Fit a new extractor fan in the bathroom with timer and an isolation switch. Currently no fan, just a window. First floor bathroom, external wall.
New induction hob being delivered next week, need a proper cooker circuit run from the consumer unit - currently only a 13A socket. About 10m cable run through kitchen units.
Fit interlinked mains smoke alarms - hallway, landing and kitchen heat alarm. Two-storey house, need it sorted for insurance.
Want 4 outside wall lights and a PIR security light by the garage. Cables to run externally clipped, switched from inside the hallway.
Partial rewire of kitchen and utility room as part of renovation - new circuits for sockets, hob, oven and lighting. Old rubber cabling found, plaster coming off anyway. 4-bed house.
Immersion heater element has gone, no hot water. Replace element and thermostat in the airing cupboard cylinder, and check the wiring while you're at it.
Install a 9.5kW electric shower replacing an old 8.5kW unit. Existing shower circuit present but may need upgrading to 10mm cable and 45A breaker, ceiling pull cord also faulty.
Doorbell stopped working - think the transformer in the hallway has died. Replace the wired doorbell transformer and check the bell push.
